records.info: This rosicrucianism book with a title in Latin (English: The Mirror of the Wisdom of the Rosy Cross) in German has one page with ciphertext at the very beginning of the book. Salutation, command, introduction or ...? As far as is known, this has never been deciphered. The complete book can be found at Zentralbibliothek Zürich, SCH R 201: https://www.e-manuscripta.ch/zuzneb/doi/10.7891/e-manuscripta-23267 Note that there are two copies of this book. Second copy: Zentralbibliothek Zürich, SCH C 1143. I only uploaded one of them. I have not checked if all the copies are identical!
